items.title: Holiday Shopping Scams Hide in Your Search Results
items.summary:
Holiday shopping scams are hiding at the top of your search results.

When you search for a gift, the first links are often paid ads from scammers — not the real store. Click one and you could hand over your credit card or personal information to a fake site that looks almost identical to the real thing.

What to do: Scroll past the top results. The organic listings below the ads are ranked by relevance, not by who paid the most. Better yet, type the store's web address directly into your browser. If you're not sure about a site, search the company name plus "complaint" or "scam" before you buy.

items.title: Windows 11 26H2 Is Free — Check If Your PC Qualifies with PC Health Check
items.summary: Windows 11 26H2 is a free upgrade for eligible PCs. Open Settings → Windows Update → Check for updates, or download the free PC Health Check app at aka.ms/GetPCHealthCheckApp to see if your hardware meets the requirements (TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, 4 GB RAM, 64 GB storage). PCs on 24H2 or 25H2 upgrade with one restart via enablement package KB5121794; older versions (23H2, 22H2, Windows 10) use the Windows 11 Installation Assistant from microsoft.com/windows11 for a full upgrade. (Source: Microsoft Support, Techdows, September–November 2026)

items.title: Firefox 160 Adds On-Device Speech-to-Text in 40 Languages — No Cloud Needed
items.summary: Firefox 160 (released November 10, 2026) includes the SpeechRecognition API for real-time, on-device speech-to-text in 40 languages — works offline, no data sent to servers. Update free at firefox.com or via Menu → Help → About Firefox. Also new: Mini Window for always-on-top tabs, Picture-in-Picture speed controls (0.25×–2×), and a "Never allow" button to block sites from repeatedly asking to handle mailto: links. (Source: Firefox 160 Release Notes, November 10, 2026)

items.title: CISA Flags Eight Actively Exploited Flaws — Patch Outlook, Chrome, and Barracuda Now
items.summary: CISA added eight vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog including flaws in Microsoft Outlook (CVE-2026-124194), Google Chrome (CVE-2026-125350), Barracuda Email Security Gateway (CVE-2026-111560, CVE-2026-116606), Cisco BroadWorks (CVE-2026-20320), Openwave Webtop (CVE-2026-111793), UnrealIRCd (CVE-2026-114713), and Check Point products (CVE-2026-123039). Update Windows, Chrome, and Outlook immediately via Windows Update and each app's built-in updater.

items.title: Fake Jury Duty Calls Targeting North Florida — Hang Up
items.summary:
Scammers are calling people in North Florida pretending to be court officials. They claim you missed jury duty and owe a fine. They demand immediate payment by gift card or wire transfer. Courts never call to demand money — they send official mail. If you get this call, hang up. Do not provide any personal information or payment.

What to do: If you're unsure whether you have a real court obligation, look up the official clerk of court phone number yourself and call them. Never use a number the caller gives you. Report the scam call to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.

items.title: Chris Titus Tech WinUtil free Windows tool installs apps, debloats, and manages updates in one click
items.summary: WinUtil (run `irm christitus.com/win | iex` in the command line Admin, or download the EXE at cttstore.com) is a free, open-source Windows utility with 30+ million runs that lets you install hundreds of apps via Winget, apply safe privacy/performance tweaks, create a System Restore point automatically, and configure Windows Update to delay feature updates by 1 year and security updates by 4 days — all in one interface. Source: christitus.com/winutil-in-2026/ — November 2026.

items.title: Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro stopped getting updates October 13 — upgrade to 26H2 free to stay secure
items.summary: As of October 13, 2026, Windows 11 version 24H2 Home and Pro editions reached end of updates — no more security patches. You must upgrade to Windows 11 26H2 (or 25H2) free via Settings > Windows Update > Check for updates to continue receiving monthly security fixes. Enterprise and Education editions remain supported until October 2027. Source: Microsoft Learn — status-windows-11-24h2 — updated November 19, 2026.

items.title: CISA Alert: Six Actively Exploited Vulnerabilities — Update Windows and Chrome Today
items.summary: CISA added six actively exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on November 10, including a Microsoft Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194) and a Google Chrome use-after-free (CVE-2026-125350). Update Windows at Settings > Windows Update and Chrome at chrome://settings/help immediately.

items.title: Windows 11 Emerging Risks Flags Vulnerable Apps and Drivers Free in Windows Security
items.summary: Windows 11's new Emerging Risks feature in Windows Security scans your PC for vulnerable third-party apps, outdated drivers, and firmware — free and built in. Open Windows Security > App & browser control to see if anything on your system is flagged.

items.title: 7-Zip 26.06 Free File Archiver Opens Every Format at 7-zip.org
items.summary: 7-Zip 26.06 (released November 6, 2026) is the free, open-source file archiver that handles 7z, ZIP, RAR, TAR, ISO, and more with high compression. Download free at 7-zip.org — no ads, no trial, just works.
